description:
Find and edit the existing employee/host record for 'Sarah Mitchell' in Lobby Track. 

1. Locate 'Sarah Mitchell' in the host/employee database.
2. Update her Department to 'Product Development'.
3. Update her Phone to '555-867-5309'.
4. Update her Email to 's.mitchell@proddev.example.com'.
5. Save the changes.

The starting record has outdated information (Marketing, old phone/email). You must update it to the new values.
